tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search exhibitors' product listings and profiles across the whole fair. Returns totals and the best-matching exhibitors with their matching listings. Use product words only (e.g. 'bamboo cutting board'). Optional filters apply to the exhibitors returned. Spends one search.

tools.name: get_exhibitors
tools.description: Full profiles for up to 5 exhibitors by ref (E1234): booths, self-declared type, founding year, certificates, staff, export markets, payment terms, and listings with prices and MOQs. Spends one search.

tools.name: price_bands
tools.description: Going prices for a product: median, middle half and median MOQ across all priced listings in matching fair categories, with the US import duty where known. Free; does not spend a search.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Who lists the paperwork each US rule for a product asks for. Checks every exhibitor selling the product (counts per rule), plus up to 10 named exhibitors and the others that list the most, in detail: which list a matching certificate, which only claim it in a product listing, which have only a forei

tools.name: us_requirements
tools.description: What a US seller must check before importing and selling a product: laws, marketplace (Amazon) rules and common buyer requests, each with its source and the certificate or test report a factory can show. Free; does not spend a search.
